def parse(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    # divider color: forms at least one full row

        if any(all(x==col for x in g[d]) for d in range(h)): dcol=col; break
    RH=[d for d in range(h) if all(x==dcol for x in g[d])]
    CW=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==dcol for r in range(h))]
    return dcol,RH,CW

def solve_final(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter()
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=0: cnt[g[r][0]]+=1
    for c in range(w):
        if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=0: cnt[g[0][c]]+=1
    dc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==dc for x in g[r])]
    vr=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==dc for r in range(h))]
    rb=bands(hr,h); cb=bands(vr,w)
    H,V=len(rb),len(cb)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    frags={}
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(rb):
        for j,(c0,d0) in enumerate(cb):
            cells=[(rr-a,cc-c0,g[rr][cc]) for rr in range(a,b+1) for cc in range(c0,d0+1) if g[rr][cc]!=0 and g[rr][cc]!=dc]
            if cells: frags[(i,j)]=(cells,)
    def paint(P,a,ca):
        if not P: return False
        fits=all(0<=p[0]<b-a+1 and 0<=q<d0-ca+1 for p,q,_ in P)
        zeros=all(out[a+r][ca+q]==0 for r,q,_ in P)
        if fits and zeros:
            for r,q,v in P: out[a+r][ca+q]=v
            return True
        return False
    for bi in range(H):
        for bj in range(V):
            a,b=rb[bi]; ca,d0=cb[bj]
            if any(out[r][cc]!=0 for r in range(a,b+1) for cc in range(ca,d0+1)): continue
            done=False
            # left/right neighbor across vertical divider column (mirror horizontally)
            for sj in (bj-1,bj+1):
                if not(0<=sj<V): continue
                s0,sd=cb[sj]
                sep = sd+1 if sj<bj else s0-1
                if 0<=sep<w and all(g[rr][sep]==dc for rr in range(a,b+1)):
                    src=frags.get((bi,sj))
                    if src:
                        P=[(r,2*sep-q,v) for r,q,v in src]
                        paint(P,a,ca); done=True; break
            if done: continue
            # up/down neighbor across horizontal divider row (mirror vertically)
            for si in (bi-1,bi+1):
                if not(0<=si<H): continue
                sa2,sb2=rb[si]
                sep = sb2+1 if si<bi else sa2-1
                if 0<=sep<h and all(g[sep][cc]==dc for cc in range(ca,d0+1)):
                    src=frags.get((si,bj))
                    if src:
                        P=[(2*sep-r,q,v) for r,q,v in src]
                        paint(P,a,ca); done=True; break
            if done: continue
            # fallback: copy from nearest fragment (translate, keeping relative shape) scanning candidates
            placed=False
            order=[('h',(bi-1),(bj)),('h',(bi+1),(bj)),('v',(bi),(bj-1)),('v',(bi),(bj+1)]
            for typ,si,sj in order:

                dr=a-min(p[0] for p in src); dcol=ca-min(p[1] for p in src)
                P=[(r-dr,q-dcol,v) for r,q,v in src]

            if placed: done=True
    return out
